description: StEER - Hurricane Laura is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Tracy Kijewski-Correa, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). Hurricane Laura made landfall as a strong Category 4 storm near Cameron, LA in the early hours of August 27, 2020, tying the Last Island Hurricane of 1856 as the strongest land-falling hurricane in Louisiana history, as measured by wind speed, tied for the fifth-strongest hurricane on record to make a continental US landfall, and ... Coverage: Lake Charles, LA. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: StEER, reconnaissance, hurricane, Hurricane Laura, structural assessment, street-level panoramic imaging. Published 2021-02-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
